ic_name: DALI (Digital Addressable Lighting Interface, IEC 62386 via TI SLAA422A)
test_cases_present: partial - SLAA422A provides reference firmware and demonstrates a working DALI control gear on the TPS62260LED-338 EVM, but does not publish a formal IEC 62386-102 conformance testbench. The test cases below are derived from the protocol description (Section 1 of SLAA422A), the supported command set (Tables 3-5), the unsupported set (Table 4), and the per-state-figure of the gear's transaction loop.
derived_compliance_test_categories: Forward-frame minimum case — direct level OFF: address byte = short address with B=0, data byte = 0 → verify lamp turns off (Actual Level := 0).
Forward-frame full-level case — direct level 254: address byte short with B=0, data byte = 254 → verify Actual Level = 254 = 100%.
Forward-frame MASK case — data byte = 255 (with B=0) → verify Actual Level unchanged.
Manchester encoding integrity — bit-error injection at mid-bit: verify silent discard (no backward frame, no level change).
Stop-bit framing — replace stop bits with mid-bit transitions → verify silent discard.
Inter-frame settle — send two forward frames < 22×TE apart → verify the second is dropped.
Address mode short — Y=0, AAAAAA = 0..63: verify only the matching gear responds.
Address mode group — Y=1, AAAAAA = group<<2: verify all gear belonging to the group respond.
Address mode broadcast — address byte = 0xFE (Y=1, AAAAAA=111111, B=0) and 0xFF (B=1) → verify every gear acts.
Indirect command 0x00 OFF → lamp off.
Indirect command 0x01 UP → fade up 200 ms at Fade Rate.
Indirect command 0x02 DOWN → fade down 200 ms at Fade Rate.
Indirect command 0x03 STEP UP → Actual Level += 1 (clamped at Max).
Indirect command 0x04 STEP DOWN → Actual Level -= 1 (clamped at Min).
Indirect command 0x05 RECALL MAX LEVEL → Actual Level := Maximum Level.
Indirect command 0x06 RECALL MIN LEVEL → Actual Level := Minimum Level.
Indirect command 0x07 STEP DOWN AND OFF → STEP DOWN; if at Min Level → OFF.
Indirect command 0x08 ON AND STEP UP → if OFF turn on first; then STEP UP.
Indirect command 0x09 ENABLE DAPC SEQUENCE → bypass fade rate for subsequent direct-level commands.
Indirect command 0x10..0x1F GO TO SCENE 0..15 → Actual Level := Scene[code & 0x0F]; verify masked scenes ignored.
Indirect command 0x20 RESET → verify all persistent variables return to defaults (two-strike commit required).
Indirect command 0x21 STORE ACTUAL LEVEL IN DTR → verify DTR == Actual Level via QUERY CONTENT DTR (0x98).
Indirect commands 0x2A..0x2F STORE DTR AS ... → verify each maps DTR into the named variable (Max/Min/SystemFailure/PowerOn/FadeTime/FadeRate).
Indirect commands 0x40..0x4F STORE DTR AS SCENE n → verify Scene[n] := DTR.
Indirect commands 0x50..0x5F REMOVE FROM SCENE n → verify Scene[n] := 0xFF (MASK).
Indirect commands 0x60..0x6F ADD TO GROUP n → verify Group bitmap bit n = 1.
Indirect commands 0x70..0x7F REMOVE FROM GROUP n → verify Group bitmap bit n = 0.
Indirect command 0x80 STORE DTR AS SHORT ADDRESS → verify Short Address := DTR (encoded 0AAAAAA1).
QUERY 0x90 STATUS → verify all 8 status bits in returned byte.
QUERY 0x91 BALLAST → verify gear answers 0xFF (YES).
QUERY 0x92 LAMP FAILURE → simulate lamp open/short → verify 0xFF response.
QUERY 0x93 LAMP POWER ON → at Actual Level > 0 verify 0xFF.
QUERY 0x94 LIMIT ERROR → request level > Maximum Level → verify backward 0xFF.
QUERY 0x95 RESET STATE → verify backward 0xFF when in reset state.
QUERY 0x96 MISSING SHORT ADDRESS → with Short Address = 0xFF verify 0xFF.
QUERY 0x97 VERSION NUMBER → verify backward returns version (e.g. 0x01).
QUERY 0x98 CONTENT DTR → verify backward = current DTR.
QUERY 0x99 DEVICE TYPE → verify backward = 0x06 (LED, IEC 62386-207).
Special command 0xA1 TERMINATE → verify exit Configuration Mode.
Special command 0xA3 DTR (data byte 0..0xFF) → verify DTR loaded.
Special command 0xA5 INITIALIZE → verify entry to Configuration Mode for 15 minutes.
Special command 0xA7 RANDOMIZE → verify Random Address regenerated.
Special command 0xA9 COMPARE → with Random Address ≤ Search Address verify backward 0xFF.
Special command 0xAB WITHDRAW → with Random Address == Search Address verify gear drops out of iteration.
Special commands 0xB1/0xB3/0xB5 SEARCH ADDRESS H/M/L → verify Search Address loads bytewise.
Special command 0xB7 PROGRAM SHORT ADDRESS → after matching, verify new Short Address stored in flash.
Special command 0xB9 VERIFY SHORT ADDRESS → with the candidate matching, verify backward 0xFF.
Special command 0xBB QUERY SHORT ADDRESS → at Random Address == Search Address verify backward = stored Short Address.
Special command 0xBD PHYSICAL SELECTION → vendor-defined (e.g. push button on gear).
Special command 0xC1 ENABLE DEVICE TYPE X → verify next forward frame is interpreted in the DT-X command space.
Special command 0xC3/0xC5 DTR1/DTR2 → verify auxiliary DTRs loaded.
Indirect command 0xC5 READ MEMORY LOCATION → at memory bank 0 verify returned byte matches LastAddressableLocation / Indicator / GTIN bytes etc.
Indirect command 0xE4 STORE DTR AS FAST FADE TIME → verify Fast Fade Time := DTR.
Unsupported command in SLAA422A — command 129 (Enable Write Memory) → verify silently ignored.
Unsupported command — special 0xC7 WRITE MEMORY LOCATION → verify silently ignored.
Unsupported commands 224..227 (Reference System Power, Enable/Disable Current Protector, Select Dimming Curve) → verify silently ignored.
Unsupported queries 242..251 (LED open/short/Change-in-Load/Thermal Overload/Thermal Shutdown/Measurement fail/Current Protector Active/Enabled) → verify command 240 indicates not supported.
Bus voltage out-of-range — drop bus below 9.5 V → verify gear holds at System Failure Level.
Bus collision — two gear answer same query (forced) → verify wired-AND degrades response; control device treats as no-response.
Two-strike commit — send 0x20 RESET twice within 100 ms → verify reset; send single 0x20 → verify ignored.
Fade-running QUERY STATUS bit 4 — issue direct level + fade time 8 s → verify bit 4 = 1 during the fade.
Inter-frame settle exact 22×TE — verify frame at 22×TE is accepted; frame at 21×TE is dropped.
Backward-frame window — measure backward start delay; verify ≥ 7×TE and ≤ 22×TE.
PHYS_MIN_LEVEL clamp — Minimum Level cannot be set below PHYS_MIN_LEVEL.
Logarithmic curve — verify Δ between adjacent levels ≈ 2.8% illumination.
Power On Level — power-cycle gear; verify Actual Level := Power On Level within 600 ms.
Information memory persistence — STORE DTR AS SHORT ADDRESS, power-cycle, verify Short Address preserved.
WDT+ fade tick — measure tick interval; verify ≈ 1 ms (8 MHz / 8192).
Configuration Mode 15-minute auto-exit — INITIALIZE, wait 15 min, verify gear exits Configuration Mode.
TI_DALI_Idle_Callback — verify it is invoked during the ≈ 7 ms idle window per § 4.4.
